code_examples.section: ltm rule command PSM HTTP disable
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PSM::HTTP::disable
       To disable PSM for HTTP traffic.

SYNOPSIS
       PSM::HTTP::disable

DESCRIPTION
       To disable PSM for HTTP traffic

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       CLIENT_ACCEPTED HTTP_REQUEST HTTP_PROXY_REQUEST
		  HTTP_REQUEST_DATA HTTP_REQUEST_SEND HTTP_REQUEST_RELEASE

EXAMPLES
	when HTTP_REQUEST {
	    if { [HTTP::uri] starts_with "/bypass" } {
		PSM::HTTP::disable
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-10.0.1 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
